summary: Phase 1.1 Compare feature tested end-to-end. Backend GET /api/projects/{id}/trend returns 200 with ASC-ordered series of completed reports including all required fields (report_id, created_at, platforms, north_star_metric/current/target). 401 returned without auth. A synthetic second completed report (rpt_synth0000001) was inserted into mongo per instructions to enable diff testing alongside existing rpt_0bed032da95d. Frontend /projects/proj_d4ba8d647a10/compare page renders with TopBar, populates both pickers with 2 completed reports, defaults picker-a to earlier (6/28) and picker-b to later (7/15) report, renders trend-chart with current + target lines (recharts .recharts-line count=2), and renders diff-section with all 5 side-by-side sections (north-star, weekly themes, content ideas, daily checklist, key risks) with both Report A and Report B columns. ProjectDetail shows 'Compare →' link (open-compare testid) and clicking navigates to /compare. Dashboard smoke loads.
passed: GET /api/projects/{id}/trend 200 with ASC-ordered 2-item series and all required fields
picker-a and picker-b populated with completed reports
Defaults to last two completed reports (a=earlier, b=later)
trend-chart renders with current + target lines
diff-section renders side-by-side panels for all 5 sections
ProjectDetail open-compare link visible when >=2 completed reports

failed.issue: Clearing both pickers (setting them to empty value) does not collapse diff-section back to the empty-state. The local a/b state holds stale fetched reports because the second useEffect only fetches when aId/bId are truthy and never resets state to null when they become empty.
failed.evidence: After selecting empty value in picker-a and picker-b, URL params cleared but diff-section still shows previous data; 'Pick two reports to compare' empty-state not displayed. Note: default load with <2 reports path was not directly exercised since the env now has 2 reports.

failed.issue: Hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on Compare page caused by Emergent dev tooling injecting span wrappers inside <option> children. Cosmetic dev-mode noise, not app code.
failed.evidence: Console error on /compare with x-ve-dynamic span inside select options

action_items: (Optional, LOW) In Compare.jsx, reset local a/b state to null when aId/bId become empty so the empty-state UI surfaces after user deselects.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 minor stale-state issue in empty-state UX)

test_credentials: Used existing mongo session token test_session_1782613812213 for user_f4640efc606a / proj_d4ba8d647a10. Inserted synthetic completed report rpt_synth0000001.
notes: Did not retest share/export-guide flows beyond noting dashboard loads, per main agent instruction.
